ios.desc:
Monity.ai helps you monitor websites for the changes that matter, without refreshing pages all day or setting up fragile rules by hand.

Use monity.ai to track price drops, stock changes, content edits, page updates, and visual differences across the sites you care about. When something important changes, you get alerted quickly so you can act fast.

What you can do in monity.ai:
- Monitor website pages for visual, text, and element-level changes
- Track price and availability updates on important pages
- Use AI-assisted setup to create monitoring tasks faster
- Get mobile push notifications when changes are detected
- Review change history and inspect what changed
- Manage tasks and workspaces from your phone

Monity.ai is built for teams and individuals who need reliable website monitoring for operations, research, compliance, ecommerce, and competitive tracking.

Whether you want to watch a competitor page, a product listing, a policy page, or any important website, monity.ai helps you stay informed without constant manual checking.

Monity offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://monity.ai/privacy-policy/
